# Raphael Bruno

> Software engineer based in Portugal, building AI agents (voice and chat), automation systems, and full-stack products.

Raphael Bruno is a software engineer specializing in AI voice agents, LLM-powered automation, and product engineering. This site is his portfolio: selected projects, technical writing, and background.

## Key pages

- [About](https://raphaelbruno.dev/about/): background, experience, and skills.
- [Projects](https://raphaelbruno.dev/projects/): case studies of shipped work, including AI voice agents, CRM automation, and data validation pipelines.
- [Blog](https://raphaelbruno.dev/blog/): technical notes and write-ups, including practical lessons on building production voice AI agents.
- [How We Work](https://raphaelbruno.dev/how-we-work/): engagement model for collaborators and clients.
